body.message:
Well noted your arrival time, Samy.

However, we would like to confirm that, as per our records, we have received the security deposit payment only, and the rental amount is still outstanding.

May I kindly know how you would prefer to settle the remaining rent balance via payment link or bank transfer?

Please note that if you choose to pay via the payment link, a 3.1% card processing fee will apply.

Kindly confirm your preferred payment method so we can assist you accordingly.

Thank you.
